name: Sirloin Steak Kabob Bowls (Marinated Sirloin with Peppers, Onion & Mushrooms)
method: sheet pan / grill (marinated sirloin cubes + non-starchy veg; skewers optional for meal prep, roast/grill on trays and weigh-and-divide)
ingredients_verbatim: 1 3/4 pounds top sirloin steak cut into 1 1/4-inch cubes
1 red bell pepper cored and cut into 1 1/4-inch pieces
1 yellow or orange bell pepper cored and cut into 1 1/4-inch pieces
8 ounces whole baby bella mushrooms (halved if large)
1 small red onion cut into 1 1/4-inch cubes
Skewers (if using wood, soak in water for 30 minutes)
why: Verified published nutrition dead-center in band: 482 cal, 24g carbs, 49g protein per serving. Whole-muscle top sirloin (board home sirloin-steak), no rice/pasta/potato base - structurally low-carb (carbs are honey + non-starchy veg). Reframes cleanly as a sheet-pan sirloin + peppers/onion/mushroom meal-prep bake that weighs-and-divides to 14; skewering is optional, not load-bearing. All main ingredients map to the Omaha board.
confidence: high on nutrition (read from source page); medium on batch-fit (native form is skewered kabobs, but the marinated-sirloin-plus-veg components portion fine as a tray bake)
